notes.title: v1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
v1.0.6 Patch Notes

• Fix: Loading could restore the save state from a different level.

• Add: “Redo Swap.” After performing a Swap—and before your next drag—you can use the on-screen button or press Left Shift to return to the pre-Swap state.

notes.title: v1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
• Fix: Corrected several translation errors in the Simplified Chinese localization.

• Improve: Refined Save/Load logic for greater stability.

• Add: New PHYSICS “Accurate” mode — reduces clipping/penetration but makes rope drag slower.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi all!

v1.0.4 Patch Notes

• Fix: Swap count did not reset after Save → Load.

• Fix: When target Swap count is 0, UI showed “≤0”; now correctly shows “=0”.

Thanks for playing and for your feedback!

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi all!

v1.0.3 Patch Notes

• Fix: After clearing level 66, “Select Level” did not show Chapter 3 stages.

• Fix: After viewing Credits, returning and opening any level left the “Thank You For Playing” label visible; it now hides as intended.

Thanks for playing and for your support!

notes.title: Unknot! Official Release & v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Huge thanks to everyone who wishlisted, tried the demo, sent feedback, and purchased the game. Your support helped this one-dev project launch—and enabled the v1.0.2 hotfix within 48 hours.
What’s new:
[olist]
Fix: Star wasn’t awarded when using fewer swaps than the target.

Audio: Soundtrack replaced with tracks by Jamesshu.

Mac: Launch issue fixed; if it still won’t start, please restart Steam and reinstall.

[/olist]
If you’re enjoying Unknot!, a review or a share helps a ton. For issues, use the Steam discussions or email me at kaxon.gxxx@gmail.com. Thank you!

notes.title: Patch Notes demo_0.3.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today we’ve released an update for “Unknot!” – version 0.3.3 – bringing macOS support and a round of polish. Full details below:


Key changes[olist]
Added native macOS build – compatible with both Apple Silicon and Intel chips.

Reduced the volume of several chalk-related sound effects so they’re less harsh.

 Refined knot-movement speed for a smoother, more responsive feel.

[/olist]
As always, if you run into any problems or have feedback, please drop us a note in the Community Hub or email us. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch Notes demo_0.3.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today we’ve shipped an update for “Unknot!” that fixes several bugs and adds full Spanish and Italian support. Full patch notes below:


Bug Fixes[olist]
Fixed the Flip-button highlight bug in level 0.2

Tweaked the target Swap count on level 1.16 for better balance

Fixed an issue where cancelling the first language change reset the game to the default language
[/olist]

New Languages[olist]
Spanish and Italian can now be selected in Settings
[/olist]


Thanks for playing the Unknot! demo! If you run into any issues, drop a message in the community or email us.

notes.title: Patch notes demo_0.2.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We’ve just pushed an update for Unknot! that includes multiple bug fixes. Full patch notes below:


Bug Fixes[olist]
The game now launches in windowed mode by default, resolving black-screen issues on certain resolutions.

Updated the fallback solution for cases where knots are invisible.

Adjusted the clear conditions in some levels, making them easier to complete.

Reworked the completion logic to fix a bug where levels sometimes failed to clear even though no overlaps were visible.

Fixed an issue where non-English players were switched to English when entering Level 2.


[/olist]
Thank you for playing the Unknot! demo! If you encounter any issues, please report them in the community or by email.

notes.title: Patch Notes demo_0.2.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, today we have launched an update to Unknot! with a variety of bug fixes, UI Changes, and added Chinese and Japanese supports. Check out the list below for full details. 


Bug Fixes 
Fixed an issue where the game could crash when clicking Next. 


UI Changes 
Fixed level-numbering issues in several stages. 

Optimized the knot positions in certain levels so they are more centered. 


Language Added 
Chinese and Japanese added—you can now select them in the settings. 



Thank you for playing the Unknot demo! If you encounter any issues, please let us know in the community or by email.
